why: The Supabase project (cnlnsaamiujselyuowzx) runs Postgres 17. Tests must run the same major, so migrations cannot pass locally and fail on db push. PGlite 0.4.x ships PG 17.5; PGlite 0.5.x ships PG 18.3 — do not bump PGlite across that line without upgrading the Supabase project first and changing this number.
